en.hubeali: H 14844 – Narrated to us Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Yahya Kowkab Al-Dam, who has said:

Abu Abdullahasws having said that: ‘The disciples of Isaas were hisas Shites, and that ourasws Shites are ourasws disciples and the disciples of Isaas were not more obedient to himas than ourasws Shites are to usasws.
But rather, Isaas said to the disciples: “[3:52] Who will be my helpers in Allah's way? The disciples said: We are helpers (in the way) of Allah”.
So No, by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, none from the Jews helped him<sup>as</sup> nor did they fight for him<sup>as</sup>.

And our<sup>asws</sup> Shites, by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, since Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Captured the Rasool Allah<sup>saww</sup>, have never ceased to help us<sup>asws</sup>, and they fought for us<sup>asws</sup>, and they were burnt, and tortured, and displaced in the cities. May Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Recompense them goodly from us<sup>asws</sup>.

And Amir-ul- Momineen<sup>asws</sup> has said: ‘By Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Even if I<sup>asws</sup> were to strike the noses of those who love us<sup>asws</sup> with the sword, they will not hate us<sup>asws</sup>, and by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, if I<sup>asws</sup> were to approach those that hate us<sup>asws</sup> and urge them by the wealth they will still not love us<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 397. Narrated to us Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Yahya Kowkab Al-Dam, who has said: Abu Abdullah (a.s.) having said that: ‘The disciples of Isa (as) were his (as) Shites, and that our (a.s.) Shites are our (a.s.) disciples and the disciples of Isa (as) were not more obedient to him (as) than our (a.s.) Shites are to us (a.s.).
But rather, Isa (as) said to the disciples: “[3:52] Who will be my helpers in Allah’s way? The disciples said: We are helpers (in the way) of Allah”.
So No, by Allah (azwj), none from the Jews helped him (as) nor did they fight for him (as).

And our (a.s.) Shites, by Allah (azwj), since Allah (azwj) Captured the Rasool Allah (saww), have never ceased to help us (a.s.), and they fought for us (a.s.), and they were burnt, and tortured, and displaced in the cities. May Allah (azwj) Recompense them goodly from us (a.s.).

And Amir-ul- Momineen (a.s.) has said: ‘By Allah (azwj)! Even if I (a.s.) were to strike the noses of those who love us (a.s.) with the sword, they will not hate us (a.s.), and by Allah (azwj), if I (a.s.) were to approach those that hate us (a.s.) and urge them by the wealth they will still not love us (a.s.)’.
